title: What's New in Sustainability: Reporting CSRD (2025 release wave 2)

chapters.title: External ESG Reporting Tool and Standards
Demo: Calculation, Posting and Data Sync

features.name: ESG Aggregation Reporting Tool
features.description: Central tool in Business Central for calculating and collecting ESG reporting information from multiple data sources with support for formulas, filters, and different calculation methods.
caveats: Manual entry needed for some data like risk assessments
Data integration must be enabled in sustainability setup

features.name: External ESG Reporting Power App
features.description: Power App tool for creating ESG assessments, configuring reporting standards, and managing reporting requirements with bidirectional synchronization to Business Central.
caveats: Requires minimum one Power App license

features.name: CSRD Compliance Reporting
features.description: Built-in support for CSRD reporting standard along with other ESG standards like Australian reporting, Indian GRIS, and SRS, providing regulatory compliance for European Union companies.

features.name: Bidirectional Data Synchronization
features.description: Two-way data synchronization between Business Central and external ESG reporting tool, allowing collection of sustainability data in Business Central and automatic population of facts in external tool.
caveats: Data synchronization must be explicitly enabled

features.name: Dataverse Connection Setup
features.description: Configuration of data connection between Business Central and Dataverse to enable the external ESG reporting Power App functionality.
caveats: Data integration must be separately enabled

features.name: Sustainability Ledger Entry Mapping
features.description: Integration of sustainability ledger entries with ESG reporting allowing mapping of carbon equivalent data and other emissions data to reporting lines with scope-based filtering.
caveats: Not all reporting lines populated from Business Central

features.name: Formula-based ESG Calculations
features.description: Support for mathematical formulas in ESG aggregation allowing percentage calculations and complex computations using standard operators like multiply, divide, plus, minus with bracket support.
caveats: Requires knowledge of financial reporting formulas

features.name: Manual ESG Reporting without Integration
features.description: Capability to use ESG aggregation tool manually without Power App integration to prepare compliance documents for manual population of CSRD and other reporting standards.

features.name: CSRD Preparation Reports
features.description: Built-in reports for collecting and printing important fields needed for CSRD and other compliance reporting, usable with or without Power App integration.
caveats: Useful as backup for manual preparation

features.name: Excel Export for XBRL Conversion
features.description: Export functionality from external ESG reporting tool to Excel format with documentation provided for XBRL conversion for final CSRD and other standard submissions.
